content: {"phoneNote":"Clean, readable first screen with a strong trade-specific image, though the opening hours chart uses too much vertical space to repeat identical 7.00–15.00 bars.","desktopNote":"Well-proportioned Swiss-style layout with clear hierarchy, held back by an oversized, redundant timeline for identical weekday opening hours and a sparse service area section.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":4,"clutter":5,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":4,"clutter":5,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Compact the opening hours section—since Monday to Friday are all 7.00–15.00, five large blue timeline bars waste screen space; combine them or place the schedule beside the 'Kje delamo' section.","Style the primary 'Pokličite nas' links in the hero and blue banner as solid buttons rather than simple underlined text links so the main action stands out.","Combine the sparse 'Kje delamo' section with the regional 'Obrt iz Ajdovščine' block above it to avoid a separate gray band for just two words."],"blockers":[]}
